message.content: {"label":"Positive","rationale":"The DPA is in force, so Clause 3 permits disclosure. Although the requester is outside the EEA and Clause 2 otherwise forbids disclosure, Schedule 1 gives Clause 3 precedence when both apply. Clause 5 also permits disclosure because the request concerns an imminent threat to life; no fact establishes the withdrawal-of-consent exception in Clause 6.","source_ids":["C2","C3","S1","F3","F4","C5","F2"]}
